text:
alex: Heads up — planning a config-only change to routing weights and batching for chat-v2 route tonight. No model binary changes. Canary 5% for 20m.

priya: What are the exact knobs? Any tenant-facing behavior change?

alex: Small adjustments: reduce streaming_concurrency from 8 -> 6, lower per_stream_token_limit 1024 -> 900, increase max_batch_size 16 -> 24, decrease batch_window_ms 25 -> 15 to reduce latency for short chats. Also tweak route_weights so small-req flow gets more capacity. This is hosted+dedicated only. Private unaffected.

jon: Please pin to a model build for dedicated tenants to avoid mismatch. Recommend model_pin: chat-v2@2026-04-02. Also add a temporary circuit-breaker: if p95 latency > 2s for 5m, route 100% to fallback-cpu for that tenant slice.

alex: Will add pin and the circuit-breaker rule. I'll attach the config snippet to the canary bundle.

deploy-bot: Queued: `/deploy-config --service=routing --change=softflow-batch-weight --canary=0.05 --duration=20m --pin=model:chat-v2@2026-04-02`

alex: Canary YAML snippet pasted into bundle:
```yaml
routing:
  route: chat-v2
  model_pin: "chat-v2@2026-04-02"
  route_weights:
    small_messages: 0.6
    long_messages: 0.4
limits:
  streaming_concurrency: 6
  per_stream_token_limit: 900
batching:
  max_batch_size: 24
  batch_window_ms: 15
circuit_breaker:
  p95_ms: 2000
  duration_ms: 300000
  action: route_to_fallback: "fallback-cpu"
```

perf-bot: [staging-preflight] ran quick load test on the bundle: 1400 reqs, errors 0, p50=95ms, p95=420ms, mem delta +3%

devops: Noting scheduled window overlaps with infra maintenance in us-east at +10m. Recommend delaying 15m or excluding us-east from the initial canary.

alex: Good catch. Let's exclude us-east for canary and start now. Will scope regionals in the deploy command.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 6267011125 1 region exclusions: us-east. Traffic fraction: 5%. Monitoring hooks: p95 latency, error rate, pod mem, KV cache hit. Auto-fail rule: error_rate > 0.8% for sliding 3m or p95 > 2000ms for 5m.

priya: Rollback plan summary: 1) Deploy-bot cancel canary 2) Reapply previous routing bundle (streaming_concurrency=8, per_stream_token_limit=1024, max_batch_size=16, batch_window_ms=25) 3) Notify customers on dedicated tenants if pinned model unpinned. Full doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/config-quick-rollback

jon: Staging looks fine. Keep an eye on tail latency for long dialogues (they could be impacted by tighter token caps).

deploy-bot: Canary t+6m metrics: traffic=5%, errors=0.2%, p50=110ms, p95=480ms, mem +4%. Token usage per request down ~6%.

alex: Good signal. Proceeding to expand to 25% in 10m assuming green.

perf-bot: Warning from remote agent: intermittent network flakiness reported in us-west region (+packet loss) starting t+12m. Recommend pausing expansion until network stabilizes.

devops: Confirming packet loss in us-west. I'm on it but advise holding expansion.

alex: Pausing ramp. Cancel expansion command. ops, ping when cleared and we'll resume.

deploy-bot: Expansion canceled at 6267011180. Canary remains at 5%.

jon: If we have to rollback, ensure we include the model_pin revert step for dedicated and run a short smoke vs known tenants.

alex: Will do. devops, update when us-west green and we'll attempt 25% then 100% if stable.

devops: us-west packet loss cleared at 6267011235. No additional drops in the last 3m.

alex: Ramping to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Ramped to 25% at 6267011240. Monitoring active.

perf-bot: t+25m snapshot: errors=0.12%, p50=115ms, p95=470ms, token_cost_delta -6.2%, mem +3.5%. No auto-fail triggers.

priya: Looks safe. Schedule full rollout to 100% in 1h unless anyone objects. I'll add a note to the release digest.

alex: Thanks all. Adding the change to the release page: https://redwood.internal/changes/6267011111-evening-softflow-config-pinback. We'll keep watch for 60m before full roll.

deploy-bot: Thread closed at 6267011250 1 config active in canary (25%).
